notes:
Internet Archive, like Frostbox:
Series playlists: paste archive.org links, tick the series, sorted by air date or episode, hide episodes, refresh finds new ones.
A cache that loads with several connections, loads the next 2 episodes ahead and plays without stopping to buffer.
Keep: an episode stays on your PC in the folder AniBox Keep.
AniBox plays archive.org's quick-starting MP4 copy unless the original is sharper.
Includes everything from 1.9.0 (lists and sync, new-episode notices, library check, TV check, subtitles, updates from here).
